Services
How I help
Practical solutions for UK catering and hospitality operations. Built inside the spreadsheets you already use — never a new platform, never a subscription.
Core
Reporting automation
Eliminate manual data entry from your weekly reports. Connect till exports, invoices and stock counts into one automated workflow.
Weekly sales, labour and cost reports refreshed in seconds
One view of spend, orders and stock across sites or events
Zero new software to buy — built in Excel or Google Sheets
Insight
Business dashboards
Transform scattered data into actionable insights: weekly sales vs labour, margin analysis and KPI dashboards that update automatically.
Site-by-site and event-by-event performance
Beverage and food gross margin tracking
Shareable summaries for owners, operations and finance leads
Planning
Forecasting & planning
Simple ordering forecasts your chef can follow and check — based on bookings, weather and your historical sales mix.
Line-level order recommendations
Fewer emergency supplier runs and less waste
Transparent logic anyone can audit
Control
Invoice processing
Supplier invoices checked against purchase orders and deliveries so price changes, short shipments and duplicate charges are caught before payment.
Line-item price and quantity variance checks
Month-end reconciliation in minutes, not hours
See the sample demonstration below
AI
Data & AI reviews
Careful, practical AI for back-office tasks: cash reconciliation, menu pricing and schedule drafting — run alongside your existing process first.
Plain-language risk assessment for each use-case
Pilot on low-risk tasks before any rollout
Human-in-the-loop by design, GDPR-conscious
Efficiency
Process optimisation
Find where your team’s hours actually go each week. Streamline month-end, stock counts and reporting across multiple locations.
Time-based audit of weekly reporting work
Elimination of copy-paste handoffs between systems
Written standard operating notes you can keep

Why this exists
Most hospitality weekly reports are late, and nobody is sure they're right. I know — I used to be the person typing them.
I keyed in every invoice by hand across two restaurants and six bars, and ran the monthly stocktake myself. This is where the frustration behind this business comes from. Today I build the spreadsheets that do that work automatically, inside the tools you already own — no new platform, no subscription, and you keep everything I build.

my consultancy work is conducted under strict confidentiality. The demonstrations in the sample section above are built on anonymised dummy data — clearly labelled, and never taken from client projects.
